purpose: Descriptive station-record counts per confirmed observation hour, with an identifiability summary for current model inputs.

method.coverage_basis: The observer confirmed all orders were recorded during both windows, with no observation breaks or omitted orders.
method.field_endpoint_convention: The confirmed start and end timestamps are included in the source counts. The last delivery event in each visit is exactly at the confirmed end.
method.clock_basis: Unconfirmed; elapsed window seconds use the recorded local clock times only.

initial_state.basis: The observer stated the count and station were not recorded and cannot be recalled; neither value is reconstructed.
No waiting customers were reported at the start; initial order identities and preparation already in progress remain unconfirmed. An entirely empty system is not assumed.

parameter_identifiability.source_support: Recorded cashier intervals are elapsed windows, not active-work segments. On Tuesday, three cashier windows overlap at 16:51:10 while one cashier is reported.

Preparation start-to-end intervals are elapsed time. Friday has a confirmed cashier interruption during preparation, but exact pause boundaries are unknown; Tuesday has six overlapping delivery windows at 17:00:10 while four preparation staff are reported.

Station arrival fields do not establish a global arrival definition or pre-start history. Tuesday customers were already waiting, but their count and station were not recorded and cannot be recalled. Initial work in preparation remains unconfirmed in both visits.
Station-local order records do not identify people or group size. The eight confirmed cashier-delivery links on Friday do not supply group counts; Tuesday station IDs remain unlinked.

Payment medium was not recorded and external payment confirmation waiting was not separated from active cashier work. A timestamp gap between cashier and delivery does not measure banking confirmation or identify the probability of paying by transfer.
Three Tuesday cashier withdrawals are recorded, but the current records do not identify a general patience input or distribution; the initial queue count and station are unavailable.

A Friday interruption of preparation to perform cashier work is confirmed, but its exact pause and resume boundaries were not timed. The 183-second elapsed preparation interval is not active preparation time.
Reported staffing can describe the observed configurations. Tuesday overlap counts are an unresolved consistency warning, not a basis to infer additional workers, assignments, or service capacity.

additional_descriptive_measure.scope: Descriptive elapsed time for the eight confirmed same-order IDs on Friday; not active labor time. No Tuesday end-to-end join is established.

limits: The rates are recorded station-stage counts per observed hour, not global arrival rate, equilibrium throughput, service capacity, utilization, or causal staffing/day-type effects.
Initial work can contribute to records observed after the start; the Tuesday initial waiting-customer count and queue station are not recorded and cannot be recalled.

Field counts include events at both confirmed endpoints; each final delivery is exactly at the end. Simulator counts using [0,H) are not directly comparable until a common endpoint-counting rule is applied.
No parameters were fitted, no acceptance thresholds were set, and no calibration or empirical validation was performed.
